timer.title: Shot timer
timer.presetSummaryInterval: {{reps}} reps · {{par}} s par time · {{rest}} s rest
timer.presetSummaryCustom: Set your own par time, ready delay and reps
timer.milsnabbLegend: SHB J.6.1/J.6.2: provserie 10 s, then 4×10 s, 4×8 s, 4×6 s. Ready delay is a practice default, not the match's 60 s LADDA→FÄRDIGA cadence.

ipscTimer.sensitivityHint: Higher sensitivity (a level closer to 0) picks up quieter shots, but also more background noise. Try High for .22 or indoors, Low next to a busy firing line — or use the live meter below to set it against your own shot's peak.
ipscTimer.liveMeterHint: Clap or dry-fire near the phone, then set the level just below the peak.
ipscTimer.liveMeterNeedsPermission: Grant microphone permission (tap Start once) to see the live level here.
ipscTimer.privacyNote: The microphone is analysed live on this device to find the shots. The recording is never stored, played back or sent anywhere — it is written to a temporary file the app can only meter, and deleted the moment the run ends.
ipscTimer.webUnavailable: The shot timer needs a native build — the microphone isn't available in this web preview.

errors.unavailable: No microphone is available on this device.
errors.denied: Microphone permission was denied — allow it in system settings to detect shots.
errors.failed: The microphone couldn't be started. Close other apps using it and try again.

faltTimer.eventsHint: Add whole seconds inside the shooting time — each boundary gives a short beep and a vibration. The numbers above the timeline are the seconds between boundaries.
faltTimer.whistle: Whistle signal instead of a spoken ELD UPPHÖR
faltTimer.sourceNote: Commands and timings per SHB 2026 D.6.2 p. 88. ELD UPPHÖR is drawn out over 3 s and ends exactly when the shooting time runs out.

commands.patronUr: Patron ur! Proppa vapen! (unload, plug the gun)

vault.addPermissionDenied: Permission denied — allow camera/photo access in system settings to add a document

photoScoring.reasonZoneContrast: No black zone was found against the card.

photoScoring.markHint: Tap each shot hole. Tap a marker to move or delete it.
photoScoring.edgeCallHint: This shot is within 1 mm of the line. Pick the value.
photoScoring.limitReached: That's all {{count}} shots for this series.
photoScoring.caliberGuessed: Caliber assumed from {{caliber}} — tap to change.

account.title: Account & sync
account.settingsRowSubtitle: Optional cloud backup across your devices
account.intro: ShotLedger works fully offline without an account. Sign in only if you want your logbook on more than one device.
account.syncUnavailableWeb: Sync is not available in the web preview.
account.deleteSubtitle: Removes your account and everything synced to the server
account.deleteBody: This deletes your account and all synced data on the server, including photos. The logbook on this device is kept. This cannot be undone.
account.deletedBody: Your server data is gone. The logbook on this device is untouched.

syncError.versionUnsupported: This app version is too old to sync. Please update.

shotlog.title: ShotLog import
shotlog.intro: Dev tool. ShotLog exports one row per session — a total, no individual shots. Each row becomes a session with a total-only series. Map the tags, then review every row before importing.
shotlog.noRowsBody: The file had no readable session rows.
shotlog.tagMappingIntro: ShotLog has no discipline, class or firearm field — it is all in the tags. Change any guess before importing.
shotlog.summaryDateUnknown: {{count}} rows share one timestamp — their real dates were lost in ShotLog and are marked date unknown.
